entities.name: DOI:10.1016/j.annemergmed.2014.10.001
observations: Keil LG, Platts-Mills TF, Jones CW. Published October 2015 in Annals of Emergency Medicine; cross-sectional analysis of registry searching in emergency medicine systematic reviews.

Article title reports that systematic reviews published in emergency medicine journals do not routinely search clinical trials registries; quantitative estimate was not available in retrieved metadata.

entities.name: Registry searches uncommon
observations: The 2015 cross-sectional analysis of emergency-medicine systematic reviews concluded, as stated in its title, that clinical-trial registry searches were not routine; retrieved records did not provide the measured proportion.
